Our inventory includes our in-house brands top-tier brands known for their potency and quality, such as STIIIZY, Element, Breeze, and Cali Blaze. This dedication to excellence has made High Society Cannabis a leading destination for high-end cannabis products in Big Rapids
about.linksLabel: More about High Society Big Rapids

items.label: Order online for pickup; curbside customers get a text when the order is ready

items.title: Who Can Shop
items.md: Recreational shopping is available to individuals 21 years or older.

items.title: Check In
items.md: Bring a valid government-issued ID or passport and check in with our security and front desk upon arrival.

items.title: Stay in the Loop
items.md: Stay informed about discounts and special offers by sharing your phone number and email with us.

items.title: Meet Your Budtender
items.md: When it's your turn, a budtender will call you from the waiting area. They’re available to assist with product selection and answer any questions, whether you're new or familiar with our offerings.

items.title: Choose Your Items
items.md: After you choose your items, the budtender will alert our order preparation team. Payments can be made using cash, credit, or debit cards.

items.title: Complete Your Purchase
items.md: Once your order is ready, a staff member will call your name, process your payment, and review the order to confirm accuracy before completing the transaction.

blocks.heading: How to Place an Order for Dispensary Pick-Up

items.title: Browse the Menu
items.md: Browse our [Big Rapids dispensary menu](/shop/big-rapids/) online or contact us at [(231) 598-9302](tel:+12315989302) for assistance.

items.title: Build Your Order
items.md: Select your preferred products, choose the quantities, add them to your cart, and schedule a pick-up time that works for you.

items.title: Check Out
items.md: Complete your order by providing your personal details. First-time visitors will need to present a valid ID for verification, while returning customers can sign in for a faster checkout process.

items.title: Curbside Pickup
items.md: If curbside pickup is your preference, let us know, and we’ll notify you via text when your order is ready.

items.title: Enjoy Responsibly
items.md: Enjoy our cannabis products responsibly. We're here to ensure a seamless shopping experience!

blocks.heading: What Our Customers Say About Us

items.q: What are the requirements to purchase from High Society Cannabis Big Rapids?
items.a: To shop at our dispensary, you need a valid government-issued ID proving you are 21 years or older. Individuals 18 and older with a medical marijuana card can also make purchases.

items.q: How should I handle a defective product?
items.a: If you experience issues with a product's quality or functionality, please call us at [(231) 598-9302](tel:+12315989302) or visit the store where you made the purchase. Our team is happy to help.

items.q: What payment methods are supported at High Society dispensaries?
items.a: High Society accepts cash and debit cards. Many locations also feature an in-store ATM for your convenience. Some stores may offer additional payment options—call ahead for details.

items.q: Is it legal to travel with cannabis?
items.a: Cannabis purchases are legal in Michigan, but transporting cannabis across state lines is prohibited under federal law. Avoid taking cannabis products out of the state.

items.q: What types of cannabis products are available?
items.a: We offer a wide range of high-quality products, including flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vape pens, edibles, and more. Check out our menu or contact us with specific inquiries.

items.q: Are there any rewards programs for regular customers?
items.a: Absolutely! Join The Society, our loyalty program, to start earning points on your purchases. Points can be redeemed for exclusive discounts and offers. Speak to our staff for more information.
